premises.text: Exploding multi-partner data sources, formats, and access frequency make inter-company data management hard technically and operationally
premises.evidence_span: This explosion in data makes managing inter-company data very hard, both technically and operationally

premises.text: A data operations platform handles how companies give and get data so teams focus on using data rather than integrating it
premises.evidence_span: Nexla is a data operations platform that takes care of how you give and get the data

premises.text: The platform is easy for operations teams, secure with encryption/access control/anonymization, and smart about schema, quality, and volume changes
premises.evidence_span: Nexla is easy to use, secure, and smart

premises.text: No-code transforms, sharing, destinations, and anomaly monitoring automate inter-company data workflows without specialized in-house pipeline builds
premises.evidence_span: It took our user no time to set this up, and no coding was required

premises.text: Built to run in every infrastructure environment for complex multi-partner ecosystems
premises.evidence_span: Nexla was built from the ground up to run in every infrastructure environment

value.text: Less time integrating data and more time creating business value through scalable secure data operations
value.evidence_span: Less time integrating, more time creating business value

causal_links.evidence_span: Less time integrating, more time creating business value

notes: Easy/secure/smart and demo transform/monitor cascade treated as facets of one data-ops platform (§4.1.7) with P3 capturing stated triad and P4 the no-code automation path. Beta customer names treated as traction, excluded. Founder bio excluded.
